# Contract First — Specs That Bite Back > **A multi-provider, multi-model AI agent skill that scaffolds machine-checkable YAML contracts, file ownership boundaries, and spec↔code guard tests so coding agents never drift.** [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Python 3 Stdlib Only](https://img.shields.io/badge/Scripts-Python%203%20Stdlib%20Only-green.svg)](skills/contract-first/scripts/) [![Multi-Provider](https://img.shields.io/badge/Providers-Antigravity%20%7C%20Claude%20Code%20%7C%20Codex%20%7C%20Cursor%20%7C%20Gemini%20CLI%20%7C%20OpenCode-purple.svg)](#installation)

--- ## Why This Exists When most of your code is written by AI agents, a constraint that lives only in your head—or in a paragraph an agent is *supposed* to remember—**is not a constraint**. - Prose rules burn context and silently rot. - Parallel agents without file boundaries negotiate interfaces *through* your codebase and leave four half-compatible versions of the same idea. - Open design decisions turn into bare `TODO`s that agents treat as permission to invent. **Contract First** turns your spec into **executable data**—three YAML contracts, JSON Schemas, a file-ownership boundary table, and automated guard tests—before the first line of implementation code is written. --- ## The Five Rules 1. **If a rule can't be tested, don't write it as a rule.** Important enough to keep → make it a test. 2. **A matrix is DATA, not a Markdown table.** Only then can tests compare it against real enums and route guards in code. 3. **One SSOT.** Never keep a parallel `.md` copy of a YAML contract. 4. **Order: Spec → Contract → Code.** Domain decides the API; API decides the layers. Unbuilt endpoints live under `x-planned-operations`. 5. **An agent that finds the contract wrong REPORTS it — it does not edit it.** Otherwise the contract becomes a scratchpad. --- ## Installation Structured for native discovery across every major AI coding harness (inspired by [`obra/superpowers`](https://github.com/obra/superpowers)): ### Universal (`npx skills`) ```bash npx skills add akatekhanh/contract-first ``` ### Antigravity (`agy`) ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/akatekhanh/contract-first ``` *(Uses `.antigravity-plugin/plugin.json` and ingests `skills/contract-first/` automatically.)* ### Claude Code Inside Claude Code: ```text /plugin marketplace add akatekhanh/contract-first /plugin install contract-first@contract-first-dev ``` *(Uses `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` + `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`.)* ### OpenAI Codex CLI / App ```bash # Via universal .agents/plugins marketplace or direct skill clone: git clone https://github.com/akatekhanh/contract-first.git /tmp/contract-first \ && cp -R /tmp/contract-first/skills/contract-first ~/.codex/skills/contract-first \ && rm -rf /tmp/contract-first ``` *(Includes `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` and `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json`.)* ### Cursor Install from repository URL using `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json` (`"skills": "./skills/"`), or clone `skills/contract-first` into `.cursor/skills/`. ### Gemini CLI ```bash gemini extensions install https://github.com/akatekhanh/contract-first ``` *(Uses `gemini-extension.json` + `GEMINI.md`.)* ### OpenCode / Hermes / Other Harnesses Point your harness at `AGENTS.md` or copy `skills/contract-first/` into your shared `~/.agents/skills/` directory: ```bash git clone https://github.com/akatekhanh/contract-first.git /tmp/contract-first \ && mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills \ && cp -R /tmp/contract-first/skills/contract-first ~/.agents/skills/contract-first \ && rm -rf /tmp/contract-first ``` Once installed, trigger it naturally in any session: - *"Set up contract-first for this repo"* - *"Scaffold the contracts before we start coding"* - *"Audit this repo with contract-first and find spec↔code drift"* --- ## What Gets Scaffolded in Your Project ```text / ├── contracts/ │ ├── business-spec.yaml # 1. Domain: actors, state machine, flows, copy, AC │ ├── openapi.yaml # 2. API + entity model (OpenAPI 3.1 + x-planned-operations) │ ├── architecture.yaml # 3. Layers, file ownership, persistence, ADRs, blockers │ └── schemas/ │ ├── business-spec.schema.json # JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 │ └── architecture.schema.json # JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 ├── tests/ │ └── test_spec.py # Strict YAML loader + schema + orphan-enum + ADR + AC guards └── AGENTS.md # Short pointer to contracts/, never restates them ``` --- ## Multi-Agent & Multi-Model Fan-Out

The `ownership` table in `contracts/architecture.yaml` acts as a second contract when fanning work out across parallel agents or mixed model families: | Role | Owns | Recommended Model Tier | Examples (Multi-Provider) | |---|---|---|---| | `ARCHITECT` | `contracts/`, entities, ports/interfaces, shared signatures | Frontier / high-reasoning | Claude Opus · Gemini Pro / Neon · GPT-5 (high) | | `AGENT-DOMAIN` / `ADAPTER` / `API` / `FE` | One implementation layer inside owned files | Mid / balanced | Claude Sonnet · Gemini Pro · GPT-5 / Codex | | `RESEARCH` | Read-only lookup & repo exploration | Fast / lightweight | Claude Haiku · Gemini Flash · GPT-5 mini | | `REVIEWER` | Diff vs. contract verification | **Separate agent / cross-model** | Pair different families (e.g., Gemini writes, Claude reviews) | See [`skills/contract-first/references/multi-agent-ownership.md`](skills/contract-first/references/multi-agent-ownership.md) for the full sequencing protocol. --- ## CLI Scripts (Zero External Dependencies) Both helper scripts use **Python 3 standard library only** and are CI-ready (`exit 0` clean, `exit 1` findings/skipped, `exit 2` error). ### 1. Scaffold a new contract bundle ```bash python3 skills/contract-first/scripts/scaffold_contracts.py /path/to/repo --name "My App" --date 2026-11-22 # Preview without writing: python3 skills/contract-first/scripts/scaffold_contracts.py /path/to/repo --name "My App" --dry-run ``` ### 2. Audit an existing repo for contract defects ```bash python3 skills/contract-first/scripts/contract_audit.py /path/to/repo --format text # CI mode (file:line:severity:message, hard failures only): python3 skills/contract-first/scripts/contract_audit.py /path/to/repo --severity HIGH ``` What `contract_audit.py` catches automatically: - Missing contract files or meta-schemas (`schemas/*.schema.json`) - Missing `# yaml-language-server: $schema=...` header lines - Duplicate YAML mapping keys (which parsers silently overwrite) - YAML 1.1 implicit-typing traps (`YES`/`NO`/`ON`/`OFF`, version floats like `1.10`, bare dates) and tab indentation - Broken ADR invariants (decided ADRs missing `date`/`rationale`; open ADRs missing `resolution_criteria`/`default_if_unresolved`, or files in `affects` written before the decision was made) - Dangling `blocked_by` references or `ownership` entries pointing to nonexistent files - Duplicate `operationId`s parked in both `paths` and `x-planned-operations` - Bidirectional `AC-*` acceptance criteria ↔ `covers("AC-...")` test markers - Parallel Markdown twins (`docs/architecture.md`, `business-spec.md`, etc.) --- ## Repository Structure ```text contract-first/ ├── .antigravity-plugin/plugin.json # Antigravity (agy) native plugin ├── .claude-plugin/ # Claude Code plugin + marketplace ├── .codex-plugin/plugin.json # Codex CLI / App plugin ├── .cursor-plugin/plugin.json # Cursor plugin ├── .agents/plugins/marketplace.json # Universal .agents marketplace ├── gemini-extension.json + GEMINI.md # Gemini CLI extension ├── AGENTS.md # Universal agent entry point ├── skills/contract-first/ │ ├── SKILL.md # Core skill instructions │ ├── references/ # Progressive-disclosure deep guides │ └── scripts/ # Zero-dependency scaffold + audit CLIs ├── tests/test_skill_layout.py # Manifest sync, layout & script smoke tests └── .github/workflows/ci.yml # Automated CI verification ``` --- ## License [MIT](LICENSE)
